question: noise floor of the skin-to-lung profile measurand under pipeline choices that must not change anatomy

cross_phase_comparison.reason: paired deltas stay blocked by Gate 1; W1 measures dispersion inside one phase only

tissue_window.affects: fat/muscle partition only, not total thickness

surface_sampling.affects: which pleural points enter the aggregate
surface_sampling.parameter: sampling bin-grid origin offset as a fraction of surface_spacing_mm

grid_jitter.affects: placement of anatomy relative to the voxel grid
grid_jitter.parameter: sub-voxel shift in voxels, applied through a shared order-1 resampler
grid_jitter.reference: own zero-shift variant, so interpolation blur is common to the family
grid_jitter.interpretation: lower bound on discretisation noise; it does not reproduce repositioning or scanner noise

aggregation.family_half_range: (max - min) / 2 across the variants of one family
aggregation.combined_half_range: square root of the sum of squared family half-ranges
aggregation.family_independence_assumption: families are treated as independent; correlated families would make this an underestimate
aggregation.phase_reduction: the worse of the two phases decides

spatial_budget.bins: existing six-direction region crossed with three axial thirds of the lung extent
spatial_budget.statistic: p95 of the absolute change of the per-bin median thickness across the variants of one family
spatial_budget.reason: the reportable 3D map needs the rib-anchored frame of Gate 1B, which does not exist yet

threshold_justification.marginal_max_mm: 2.5 mm is the z-spacing of DIR-Lab COPDgene, the only dataset that keeps the chest wall inside the FOV; a noise floor above one slice thickness means the reported number is dominated by pipeline choices
threshold_justification.feasible_max_mm: 1.0 mm keeps at least a 3:1 margin against the provisional target effect
threshold_justification.target_resolvable_effect_mm: planning anchor for the order of magnitude only; it is NOT a measured respiratory effect and must not be reported as one

decision_rule.separate_fat_muscle_allowed: fat and muscle each reach feasible or marginal under the same thresholds
decision_rule.combined_soft_tissue_only: median_soft_tissue_mm reaches feasible or marginal while fat or muscle does not

out_of_scope: any comparison between inspiration and expiration
any paired delta or respiratory effect
any change to the frozen J1.2 protocols
